proposals.evidence: Turner nirmala explicitly records Bihari nīman beautiful, Bhojpuri nīman good and Hindi nīman good/healthy. These eastern survey good forms are compared with that clean/good family. The related-looking Hindi niman well-finished under nirmāṇa/nirmiṇoti is distinguished by sense; local contact transmission remains open.
